epic.title: Foundations
epic.description: Database, sign-in, the app shell and design system, languages, the generated API client, installing the app and observability.

features.title: Database schema v1
tasks: EF Core model: species, forms, versions, types, moves, learnsets, evolutions
Rankings, raid scores and PvP IV tables
Live data: raid bosses, Max bosses, events, egg pools, research (source, fetched-at, admin-fixed lock)
Users, settings, collections, saved filters, import runs, AI usage
Initial migration and dev seed

features.title: Google sign-in, tokens and roles
tasks: Google OAuth sign-in (authorization code + PKCE)
Own access and refresh tokens, rotation, sign-out everywhere on this device
Admin role from configuration
Sign-in screen / modal with 'Not now'; return to where you were
Signed-out prompts on personal screens (collection, saved filters, AI)
Security review: token storage, CSRF, CORS, rate limits

features.title: App shell and design system
tasks: Design tokens from design/source/base.css: colours, type colours, Nunito, spacing
Phone layout: bottom tab bar, tab headers with search/Ask/profile, detail header with back + Ask
Desktop layout: sidebar (tabs, quick links, Settings, Admin for admins) and top bar
Theme: follow device / light / dark, with a dark version of every fixed colour
Shared components: cards, chips, pills, segmented switch, type badges, version markers, sprite box
Routing and deep links for every screen

features.title: Languages: English and Português (Portugal)
tasks: i18next set-up; language saved per user (or device when signed out)
All interface text extracted; English strings
Portuguese (Portugal) translation of the interface
Dates, numbers and plurals per language

features.title: OpenAPI and generated client
tasks: OpenAPI document with examples
Generated TypeScript client and TanStack Query hooks
Contract check: generated client matches the API in CI

features.title: Installable web app and offline screen
tasks: PWA manifest, icons, splash and service worker for the app shell
'Install the app' in Settings and install prompt
Offline screen with Try again and automatic reload

features.title: Out-of-date warning
tasks: API: freshness per data kind (3 days game data, 9 days raids/events)
Orange warning banner where stale data appears

features.title: Observability and errors
tasks: Application Insights for API, jobs and web
Friendly error pages and error boundary
Structured logs without personal data
